mapper.select: SELECT id, login_id, password_hash, account_type, organization_type FROM account WHERE login_id = #{loginId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT CASE phone_code WHEN 'dev-precinct-cmd-phone-01' THEN '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000201' WHEN 'dev-precinct-car-01' THEN '50000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' WHEN 'dev-precinct-phone-01' THEN '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000101' WHEN 'dev-alpha-cmd-phone-01' THEN '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000204' WHEN 'dev-alpha-phone-01' THEN '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000205' WHEN 'dev-support-cmd-phone-01' THEN '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000206' WHEN 'dev-support-car-01' THEN '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000207' WHEN 'dev-support-phone-01' THEN '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000208' ELSE CAST(id AS VARCHAR) END AS id, phone_code, account_id FROM police_phone WHERE phone_code = #{phoneCode} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
